title: Edamame quinoa bowl with miso dressing
steps: Rinse the quinoa and cook it in 240 ml water for 15 minutes.
Boil the edamame for 4 minutes, dice the tofu and fry briefly.
Stir the miso with rice vinegar, maple syrup, sesame oil, grated ginger and 2 tbsp water.
Arrange the quinoa, edamame, tofu, grated carrot, red cabbage and avocado in bowls, drizzle with the dressing and sprinkle with sesame.
